# Unit note that the mapping depends on:
#   collector.py:190-193 documents tokenspeed:kv_cache_usage_perc as
#   "Fraction of device KV pages in use (0-1)" -- a RATIO, despite the
#   "_perc" suffix that vLLM uses for a 0-100 percentage.

# HELP tokenspeed:num_requests_running Requests with scheduler-side generation state (decode path).
# TYPE tokenspeed:num_requests_running gauge
tokenspeed:num_requests_running{model_name="gpt-oss-20b"} 2.0
# HELP tokenspeed:num_requests_waiting Requests waiting in the C++ scheduler queue.
# TYPE tokenspeed:num_requests_waiting gauge
tokenspeed:num_requests_waiting{model_name="gpt-oss-20b"} 5.0
# HELP tokenspeed:kv_cache_usage_perc Fraction of device KV pages in use (0-1).
# TYPE tokenspeed:kv_cache_usage_perc gauge
tokenspeed:kv_cache_usage_perc{model_name="gpt-oss-20b"} 0.375
# HELP tokenspeed:prefix_cache_hits Number of prefix cache hits.
# TYPE tokenspeed:prefix_cache_hits counter
tokenspeed:prefix_cache_hits_total{model_name="gpt-oss-20b"} 128.0
# HELP tokenspeed:prompt_tokens Number of prompt tokens processed.
# TYPE tokenspeed:prompt_tokens counter
tokenspeed:prompt_tokens_total{model_name="gpt-oss-20b"} 4096.0
# HELP tokenspeed:generation_tokens Number of generation tokens produced.
# TYPE tokenspeed:generation_tokens counter
tokenspeed:generation_tokens_total{model_name="gpt-oss-20b"} 512.0
# HELP tokenspeed:num_requests Number of requests processed.
# TYPE tokenspeed:num_requests counter
tokenspeed:num_requests_total{model_name="gpt-oss-20b"} 16.0
